info.title: Eclair
info.summary: Media processing jobs: create them, follow them, receive their results.
info.description:
The protocol between Eclair and its clients. Version 1 (`/v1`) only changes additively: new fields, endpoints, operations and enum values, never removed or renamed ones.

Request bodies refuse unknown fields, so typos are caught. Responses and webhook bodies can gain fields: clients ignore the ones they don't know.

Errors use `application/problem+json` (RFC 9457).

tags.name: Jobs
tags.description: Run a pipeline of operations on one input.

tags.name: Presets
tags.description: Named pipelines, global or of the project.

post.description: Validates the job (the body, then each task's options against its operation's schema), stores it and queues its first tasks. The task graph must be acyclic.

202.description: The job is accepted. A replay with the same `Idempotency-Key` and body returns the first response.

parameters.name: status
parameters.description: Only jobs with one of these statuses.

parameters.name: createdAfter
parameters.description: Only jobs created after this time.

parameters.name: metadata
parameters.description: Only jobs whose `metadata` has these top-level values: `metadata[mediaId]=42`. Compares as strings.

200.description: The job, its tasks and their outputs.

post.description: Cancels the pending and running tasks. Tasks that ended keep their outputs. Canceling an ended job changes nothing and returns it.
Runs the failed and canceled tasks again, and the tasks that depend on them.

409.description: The job is still running, or has no failed or canceled task.

get.description: Server-sent events with the job's status and progress changes. Each event's `event` field is the `type` of its data, and its `data` field is a `JobEvent` as JSON. The stream ends after the job ends.
The project's presets and the global ones. A project preset hides a global one with the same name.

200.description: Every preset the project can use.

put.summary: Create or replace a project preset
put.description: Each change gives the preset a new version. Jobs record the version they used.

delete.description: Global presets can't be deleted with a project key. Jobs that used the preset keep their pipeline.

get.description: The operations this server provides and this project may use, with their options schema. Clients can validate options or build forms from it.

post.description: Sent when a task completes, to projects that subscribe to it, so they can attach outputs as soon as they exist. The body is the whole job, and `Eclair-Task` names the task.

parameters.name: Eclair-Task
parameters.description: Name of the task that completed.

put.summary: Write a file to an `http` storage
put.description: With an `http` storage, workers send each output file to `PUT {endpoint}/{path}`. Retried until the endpoint answers `2xx`: the same path can be written twice.

requestBody.description: The file. `Content-Type` is its detected mime type.

get.summary: Read a file from an `http` storage
get.description: Workers read an input with `GET {endpoint}/{path}`. The signature covers the timestamp, the path and the SHA-256 of an empty body.

apiKey.description: A project's API key: `Authorization: Bearer <key>`. Keys have scopes: `jobs:read`, `jobs:write`, `presets:write`.

PresetName.name: name
PresetName.description: Preset name. A `/` in it is encoded as `%2F`: `/v1/presets/mediatheque%2Fvideo`.

IdempotencyKey.name: Idempotency-Key
IdempotencyKey.description: Makes the request safe to retry. A replay with the same key and body returns the first response. The same key with another body is refused.

EclairDelivery.name: Eclair-Delivery
EclairDelivery.description: Id of the delivery. Retries keep it: use it to ignore duplicates.

EclairSignature.name: Eclair-Signature
EclairSignature.description: `t=<unix time>,v1=<hex>`: the HMAC-SHA256 of `{t}.{body}` with the project's webhook secret. Refuse timestamps older than five minutes.

EclairJob.name: Eclair-Job
EclairJob.description: Id of the job the file belongs to.

EclairContentSha256.name: Eclair-Content-Sha256
EclairContentSha256.description: SHA-256 of the body, in hex.

EclairStorageSignature.name: Eclair-Signature
EclairStorageSignature.description: `t=<unix time>,v1=<hex>`: the HMAC-SHA256 of `{t}.{path}.{sha256 of the body}` with the project's webhook secret. Refuse timestamps older than five minutes.

post.description: Sent to the job's webhook URL when it ends. Retried with exponential backoff for 24 hours until the receiver answers `2xx`. Receivers must accept duplicates.

Unauthorized.description: No API key, or an unknown or revoked one.

Forbidden.description: The key doesn't have the scope, or the project may not use this operation or provider.

IdempotencyConflict.description: The `Idempotency-Key` was used with another body.

Invalid.description: The request is invalid. `errors` lists the messages by JSON pointer.

TooManyRequests.description: The project reached one of its limits.

Retry-After.description: Seconds to wait before trying again.

WebhookReceived.description: Received. Any other answer is retried.

TaskName.description: Name of a task in a job. It is also the name of its outputs: the handle the application reads.

OperationName.description: Name of an operation, `<domain>.<action>` or `probe`, optionally with a major version: `video.hls@1`. Without a version, the latest one.

PresetName.description: Name of a preset. A `/` groups presets: `mediatheque/video`.

StorageName.description: Name of one of the project's storages.

Kind.description: Kind of a file, detected from its content.

Metadata.description: Free object of the client, returned as is in the job and the webhooks.

url.description: `https` URL of the file, for example a presigned URL. Fetched through the SSRF guard.

Input.description: The file to process: a URL, or a path in one of the project's storages.

StoragePath.description: Path in a storage, without a leading `/`.

MimeHint.description: The mime type the client expects. A hint: Eclair detects the real one from the content.

SizeHint.description: The size in bytes the client expects. A hint, checked against the project's limits before downloading.

OutputTarget.description: Where output files are written. Optional when no task writes files.

prefix.description: Prefix of every output path, usually ending with `/`.

path.description: Pattern of each output file's path, after the prefix. `{task}` is the task's name, `{file}` the file's name.

TaskCondition.description: Runs the task only if the probed input matches every given condition. Otherwise the task is `skipped`.

mime.description: Mime types, with `*` for a subtype: `image/*`.

from.description: Name of the task whose output is this task's input. Defaults to the job's input. `h264:file` picks one output file of that task.

options.description: Validated against the operation's options schema (see `GET /v1/operations`).

after.description: Extra dependencies, for ordering without using an output.

keep.description: `false` for an intermediate output, deleted when the job ends.

JobRequest.description: A job: an input, where to write the outputs, and a pipeline: a preset, inline tasks, or both. Without a preset, `tasks` is required. Tasks with the same name as a preset's task replace it.

webhook.description: URL called when the job ends. Defaults to the project's webhook.

failFast.description: Cancel the remaining tasks as soon as one fails.

TaskErrorCode.description: Stable error code: `input_unreadable`, `unsupported_input`, `timeout`, `limit_exceeded`, `operation_failed`, `storage_failed`, `provider_failed`. New codes can be added: treat unknown ones as `operation_failed`.

name.description: Name of the file within the task's outputs.

path.description: Path in the job's output storage.

checksum.description: SHA-256 of the file, in hex.

role.description: What the file is for, when a task writes several: `main`, `thumbnail`, `segment`…

count.description: For files with many parts (HLS segments, a thumbnail series): how many parts are not listed.

metadata.description: Data extracted by the task. Its shape depends on the operation.

op.description: The operation that runs, always with its version: `video.hls@1`.

progress.description: From 0 to 1, while the task runs.

preset.description: The preset the job used, and its version at that time.

tasks.description: Every task of the resolved pipeline, by name.

NextCursor.description: Cursor of the next page, `null` on the last one.

scope.description: `global` presets come with the server or the admin API, `project` presets are the project's own.

accepts.description: Inputs it can read. Other inputs are refused before anything runs.

Signature.description: `t=<unix time>,v1=<hex HMAC-SHA256>`. Several `v1` values can follow: the signature is valid if one of them matches.

type.description: URI of the problem type. `about:blank` when the status says it all.

errors.description: Validation errors: messages by JSON pointer to the invalid value in the request body (`/tasks/h264/options/codec`). The empty pointer is the body itself.
